native_projection.owner: RemapCoords in src/landscape.h; native pixels before ZOOM_BASE scaling

native_frame_policy.construction: placement_preview_only; CmdBuildLaunchCenter installs a complete facility, no facility construction clock
native_frame_policy.ready: static empty facility; logical frames alias the same selected hardware
native_frame_policy.working: only actual workshop/service/pod work or SpaceTransition preparation/turnaround selects declared equipment parts
native_frame_policy.blocked: static hardware/status from actual native admission/wait reason; no work or queue advancement

contract.native_occupant_policy: LaunchOperations workshop/service/pod_workshop/pad_active/pad_queue reference existing paid actors; rocket/probe/pod art stays separate
contract.native_inventory_policy: Original station/hub/vehicle CargoPackets only; storage art creates no stock or freight delivery
contract.native_water_policy: At least one actual orthogonal navigable Surface water edge; source art fixes no water side and contains no decorative water
contract.native_freight_policy: Joined or explicitly linked same-company Surface rail/lorry members retain their own footprints; no baked track, road, vehicle or station extension

model.pad: One empty 1x2 launch plate with a slim service gantry
model.workshop: One low 2x2 assembly/service hangar, no second building
model.storage: One low 4x1 covered freight/storage strip, empty of cargo
model.height_policy: Keep each cell's registered pixels inside its native 64x64 canvas; validate the selected original before approving height
model.style: Existing M1 chunky isometric machinery; pale gray/cream, charcoal, dark blue glazing, restrained ochre hardware; upper-left light
